summary: Avoid ambiguous post-commit SQLite index contention (issue316)

delivery.outcome: A durable ticket mutation succeeds despite SQLite BUSY/LOCKED during projection update; a durable invalidation token prevents stale caches being current in another process. Preserve CAS and idempotency and propagate unrelated failures.
nonGoals: No pre-write lock retry, live lock deletion, runtime hotpatch, managed adoption changes, or other retained worktree takeover.
Index rebuild liveness and native deployment remain with existing owner issues313/317.

architecture.decision: Handle contention at the existing post-commit projection boundary. Use a SQLite-independent atomic invalidation token in full and cached-signature probes; the normal rebuild reconciles it.

dataChanges.description: Disposable index signature includes an atomic invalidation token; authoritative ticket format remains compatible.

architecture.rollback: Revert the source slice through protected publication; index is disposable and rebuilt from authoritative tickets. Reinstate the prior immutable runtime if a qualified rollout fails.

validation.evidence: Real SQLite writer contention, API acknowledgement, cross-process stale guard, eventual rebuild and upsert/delete paths.
Pre-write failures, unrelated index errors, CAS and evidence replay remain correct.
Scoped Testless, protected exact-head/current-base OneDev and independent Validator publication; runtime deployment is a separate receipt.
